Clinical updates At ESID 2026, Pharming presented positive Phase II data for leniolisib in patients with genetically defined primary immunodeficiencies (PIDs) with immune dysregulation linked to PI3Kδ signaling; Pharming expects topline Phase II results from its separate trial in CVID patients with immune dysregulation, with or without an identified genetic cause, in November 2026.
Topline results from the pivotal FALCON study are expected approximately one year after the completion of enrollment.
